items.titleZh: OpenAI 的人工智能代理需要迎头赶上
items.titleEn: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能的行业发展。来源要点：OpenAI 普及了现代生成式 AI 聊天机器人，但随着 2026 年 DevDay 活动的临近，它在业界最热门的类别之一：持续运行、面向消费者的 AI 代理方面落后了。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI popularized the modern generative AI chatbot, but as its 2026 DevDay event approaches, it's fallen behind in one of the industry's hottest categories: continuously running, consumer-facing AI agents.
items.overviewZh: The Verge AI 发布了有关“OpenAI 的人工智能代理需要迎头赶上”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: The Verge AI published a new update about “OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up”.

items.titleZh: Lenfest 研究所通过扩大 OpenAI 支持发展具有里程碑意义的项目
items.titleEn: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 博客报道了人工智能领域的业务发展。消息来源的要点：OpenAI 正在扩大 Lenfest AI 协作和奖学金计划，提供 500 万美元的资金以及高达 500 万美元的软件信贷和工程支持。
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports a business development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.
